_description: Player character file — Mistfall campaign. Player: Sam (discord 100000000000000002). Character: Sable Morrow.

meta.race: Half-fae (appears fully human; fae heritage is not common knowledge)
meta.class_: Wayfinder (Dexterity/Charisma — reads the land and the deal)
meta.history: Sable never met their fae parent. Their mother was a travelling healer who made a bargain she did not finish reading — and died before she could pay it. Sable has been living in the spaces between debts ever since: not pursued, but aware that the Pale Court has a file on their family. They have a talent for finding things and people, a tendency to hear what mist-wraiths say when they think no one is listening, and a strong preference for not staying in one place long enough to accrue new debts.

spells.name: Veil-sense (passive)
spells.description: Sable can sense the presence and approximate direction of active fae bargains within 30 metres. The sense is a low hum behind the ears — stronger when a bargain is recent or under strain. This is a passive racial trait, not a spell; no action required.

spells.name: Whisper-step
spells.description: Once per short rest, Sable may move through fog or mist (including Veil-fog) without leaving any trace — no sound, no footprints, no scent. The effect lasts until Sable stops moving or speaks.

conditions.name: Fae-touched (heritage)
conditions.description: Cold iron is mildly uncomfortable to handle (not harmful, but Sable avoids prolonged contact). Fog-wraiths can sense Sable's fae heritage and may react with wariness rather than immediate hostility.

equipment.name: Short sword (iron, not cold iron)
equipment.description: Plain and practical. The handle is wrapped in cord.

equipment.name: Leather armour (worn)
equipment.description: Well-maintained, quietly expensive. AC 12 + Dex mod.

equipment.name: Hooded cloak (dark green)
equipment.description: Helps with both weather and disappearing into treelines.

inventory: A small mirror (polished steel — useful for checking corners in Veil-fog)
Chalk (white, one stick — Sable knows how to draw a basic protective circle but has never tested it against fae)
A ribbon of grey silk — a keepsake from their mother, smells faintly of lavender and iron
A folded letter from Oryn that reads: 'I think we should go the same direction. The Veil is not coincidence.'

goals: Find out if the Pale Court has an active file on the Morrow family — and whether the debt transferred to Sable when their mother died
Stay alive and free of new bargains — existing debt is enough
Help Oryn read the charter if it is found. Sable cannot read well but understands fae legal phrasing instinctively.

relations.acteur:oryn-ashveil: Met three days ago on the road. Oryn reads contracts, Sable reads people — between them they might actually survive this. Cautious trust.
relations.acteur:mosswick: Sable's Veil-sense pinged the moment they heard Mosswick's name. Someone with that much debt doesn't walk around that easily. Watching carefully.
relations.faction:pale-court: The hum behind Sable's ears gets louder the closer they get to Thornwick. The Court knows Sable is here.

secrets: Sable's mother's bargain is NOT fully discharged — one clause remains unpaid. The Lady of Sighs knows. She has not collected yet because she is interested in what Sable will become.
Sable can hear fog-wraiths when they whisper to each other in the Veil. They know this is not normal even for half-fae, and do not understand it yet.
The ribbon of grey silk was a gift from the Lady of Sighs to Sable's mother on the day the bargain was made. Sable carries it without knowing its origin.
